name: Taskbarchy
author: Xenobones
description: Windows 11 style taskbar/dock for Omarchy, with a power button, a workspace per pinned app, an Omarchy bar toggle, and a live mirror of the Omarchy bar's right-hand widgets (tray, network, audio, bluetooth, power and friends) while the bar is hidden. Personal fork of maximxmoroz.win11-dock; reads the same ~/.config/omarchy/win11-dock.json settings.
